description: MEDIA-ILL-01: Library of Congress photographs and prints selected by visual review (Claude, Project Director) to replace HY-02 batch 1 code-generated SVGs. Ingest with tools/media/loc_ingest.py; the tool re-checks the rights advisory and the date (public domain: published more than 95 years ago, 'No known restrictions on publication'). inset = fraction trimmed from [left, top, right, bottom] to remove plate borders and captions; focus = crop centre [x, y] in 0..1.
